Bug Summary:
Checkout cannot be completed using 
error_user
Preconditions:
Logged in as error_user, with Sauce 
Labs Backpack in the cart.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/.
2. Log in with error_user / secret_sauce
3. Add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart.
4. Open the cart and click Checkout.
5. Enter First Name: Test.
6. Attempt to enter Last Name: User.
7. Enter Postal Code: 75001.
8. Click Continue.
9. On the order overview page, click Finish.
Expected Result:
Required customer information should be validated. 
After valid information is entered, checkout should 
complete successfully.
Actual Result:
Last Name field did not accept input.
Continue advanced despite the missing last name.
Clicking Finish did not complete the order
or display confirmation.
Environment:
Chrome on macOS; reproduced in 
Chrome Incognito.
Notes:
Reproduced twice using error_user. Checkout succeeded 
using standard_user. error_user is a special SauceDemo 
account designed to expose problematic behavior.
